# Model check

A **track** is one sequential line of work; steps in the same track never overlap, and anything that happens while something else happens belongs in a different track. Each **step** has exactly one duration kind: `fixed` (a set number of seconds), `variable` (a min, max, and default in seconds), or `indefinite` (runs until manually stopped). A **startTrigger** anchors each step to the clock or to another step — `programStart` (t=0), `programStartOffset` (t=offset), `afterStep` (when another step ends or starts), `afterStepWithBuffer` (when another step ends plus a delay), `manual` (user tap), `onAbort` (if another step is aborted), or `compound` (wait for all or the first of several triggers). **stepId**s are globally unique across the entire program, not scoped to a track. Every `task` that a step occupies must have a matching `resourceConstraints` entry; that entry's `maxConcurrent` value enforces how many steps can use a single oven, microphone pack, projector, or desk at the same instant. Work repeated n times (n speakers, n slide loads, n changeovers) is declared as `replicates: {count: n, mode: "serial" | "parallel" | "stagger"}` on a single step—never as n copied steps or tracks. Chain what follows each repetition with `{"type":"afterStep","stepId":"<step>","instances":"each"}`; give the step that waits for all instances to finish `{"instances":"all"}`; and when a holding area between them (a foyer that can hold one coffee service, a lapel pack that can be clipped to one speaker at a time) only fits k concurrent uses, set `replicates.maxInFlight: k` to hold the upstream step instead of stranding downstream work.

```json
{
  "acknowledgement": "tracks are sequential lines of work; one duration kind per step; triggers link steps; every task needs a resourceConstraint; stepIds are global",
  "resourceConstraints": [
    { "task": "projector", "maxConcurrent": 1, "description": "one projector, cannot load deck while a talk is on screen" },
    { "task": "lapel_pack", "maxConcurrent": 1, "description": "one lapel microphone pack, must be unclipped and re-clipped between speakers" },
    { "task": "av_desk", "maxConcurrent": 1, "description": "one AV desk, runs line check, projector test, slide loads, records, strikes" },
    { "task": "lectern", "maxConcurrent": 1, "description": "one lectern, holds one speaker at a time" },
    { "task": "foyer", "maxConcurrent": 1, "description": "one foyer service area, holds coffee station and must be clear before third changeover" },
    { "task": "chair", "maxConcurrent": 1, "description": "session chair, introduces speakers and manages Q&A timing" }
  ],
  "actors": 2,
  "actorRoles": ["AV technician / desk operator", "session chair"]
}
```
